query:
SELECT
                    b.fingerprint,
                    (
                        SELECT lb.absolute_path
                        FROM library_books lb
                        WHERE lb.book_fingerprint = b.fingerprint
                          AND lb.absolute_path != ''
                        ORDER BY lb.absolute_path ASC, lb.library_id ASC
                        LIMIT 1
                    ) AS "absolute_path?: String"
                FROM books b
